svg.title: Browser frontend — modules and screens
svg.desc: frontend/js (ES modules, no framework). main.js builds one shared context and hands it to every screen. Screens subscribe on mount and the Screen base class releases every subscription and timer on unmount, so changing screens never leaves duplicate listeners.

- ctx : Context // shared with every screen
<<interface>> = abstract class with only pure virtual methods; <<abstract>> = has some.
